author: TeIq
content:
**Design doc**: .design/mod-policy-workbook.md
**Implements**: REQ-A1..A5 (mod_policies schema + indexes), REQ-B1 (action_policy_citations); AC-1, AC-2, AC-2b

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000046_mod_policies.sql
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000047_action_policy_citations.sql
- polaris-backend/src/repo/mod_policies.rs
- polaris-backend/src/repo/action_policy_citations.rs

**Repo API (mod_policies.rs)**:
- insert_initial(tx, identifier, fields..., created_by) -> Result<ModPolicy>
- amend(tx, identifier, patch, created_by, change_summary) -> Result<ModPolicy>
- current_by_identifier(pool, identifier) -> Result<Option<ModPolicy>> (LRU-cached, 60s TTL — REQ-B4)
- at_version(pool, identifier, version) -> Result<Option<ModPolicy>>
- history(pool, identifier) -> Result<Vec<ModPolicy>>
- list(pool, filters) -> Result<Vec<ModPolicySummary>>
- pause(tx, identifier, until) -> Result<()>
- resume(tx, identifier) -> Result<()>

**Repo API (action_policy_citations.rs)**:
- insert_for_action(tx, action_id, &[(identifier, version)]) -> Result<()>
- citations_for_action(pool, action_id) -> Result<Vec<Citation>>

**Rust quality (rust-quality + .crosslink/rules/rust.md)**:
- Every SQL through sqlx::query! / sqlx::query_as! — parameterized only
- thiserror-derived error enum with named variants (StaleVersion, RetiredPolicy, UnknownIdentifier, ConcurrentEdit)
- amend() takes SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the current version row before INSERT-successor + UPDATE-effective_until — REQ-A1 + REQ-F1 concurrent-edit invariant
- ON DELETE RESTRICT on the citations FK; supersession is non-destructive
- Doctest on every pub fn

**Tests**:
- tests/mod_policies_repo.rs — insert + amend + history round-trip; concurrent-edit serialisation
- tests/action_policy_citations_integrity.rs — FK rejects citation to nonexistent (identifier, version); composite PK rejects duplicate

**Pattern to mirror**: polaris-backend/src/repo/action.rs
